title: The Place
summary: A fragmented memoir about place, belonging, and the traces people leave behind in a workplace or closed institution. Desks, files, handwriting, objects and unnamed marks remain while people disappear, move on, or are replaced.

reality_weaving.imaginative_transformation: The workplace and closed-house readings remain simultaneously possible. A desk can be a place of work, a cell-like station, or simply a place temporarily assigned to a person.
reality_weaving.emergent_question: When a person leaves a place, what remains of them, and what makes a place belong to anyone at all?

alt.tr: Karanlık ve aydınlık iki atmosferin birleştiği eski bir çalışma mekânında, masasının başında oturan anlatıcı; dosyalar, boş masalar ve geride kalan izler.
alt.en: The narrator seated at a desk in an old workplace where dark and warm spaces merge, surrounded by files, empty desks, and traces left behind.

links.note: The threshold of the previous chapter becomes a question of where a person belongs.
The next chapter shifts attention from place to voice and what remains recorded.

tr.title: Yer
tr.summary: Masa, dosya ve geride kalan izler üzerinden bir yere ait olmanın ve bir yerin insana ait olmasının belirsizliği anlatılır.

en.title: The Place
en.summary: A fragmented chapter about belonging, desks, files, and the traces people leave behind.
